text: The public Solana RPC endpoints are rate-limited and are not meant for production. text: Borrowing uses one universal operate call. Signed string `colAmount` (collateral) and `debtAmount` (debt), both in base units, select the action: positive colAmount deposits, negative withdraws, positive debtAmount borrows, negative repays; `positionId: 0` creates a new position NFT. POST /borrow/operate returns {nftId, transaction} (a base64 unsigned VersionedTransaction). POST /borrow/operate-instructions returns {nftId, instructions, addressLookupTableAddresses}, so the caller must load those lookup tables when compiling a v0 message. (high confidence)

text: Integrator-sponsored gas: set payer to a wallet other than taker (no effect if equal). Dflow and OKX become ineligible while Metis and JupiterZ still compete. On a Metis route the payer covers all gas types and must sign; on a JupiterZ route the market maker pays signature and priority fees, the payer funds only the missing output-token-account rent, and the payer is a required signer only when the output is an SPL token (match signers by public key). Jupiter advises pairing payer with referralAccount and referralFee so the fee recovers the gas. On /build the payer replaces the taker as fee payer on every returned instruction, and the caller must collect both signatures and send the transaction. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06)

text: Choose the path by whether the transaction must change. Use /order + /execute by default (all routers compete, managed landing, RTSE, automatic gasless). text: A perps trade is an on-chain request. The trader's action creates a PositionRequest account, a PDA derived from the Position account, constant seeds and a random counter, plus a PositionRequestATA token account that holds the tokens in transit. Non-TP/SL requests close as soon as they are executed or rejected. TP/SL requests stay on-chain until triggered. Each request has an `executed` flag. The CLI's types identify both limit orders and TP/SL orders by `positionRequestPubkey`. (high confidence)

text: The Borrow API does not wrap or unwrap native SOL. text: Accounts are resized in place, so a dataSize filter rots. text: The /swap/v2/execute endpoint has its own rate-limit bucket, separate from the main limit: Keyless 20 RPS, Free 50 RPS, and 100 RPS for Developer, Launch and Pro. text: klend-sdk converts every Decimal to mint atoms and floors silently. A value finer than the mint (for example 1.0000009 on a six-decimal mint) moves only 1.000000 on chain, and a minSharesOut below one atom becomes 0, which gives no slippage protection. The Solana Foundation integration rejects values finer than the mint instead of clamping them. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06)

text: V2 has two paths. The Meta-Aggregator path (/order + /execute) lets Metis (Jupiter's onchain router), JupiterZ (RFQ market makers), Dflow and OKX compete for each quote, and Jupiter lands the transaction with its Jupiter Beam pipeline and its own priority-fee strategy. The Router path (/build) uses Metis only, returns raw instructions, charges no Jupiter swap fee, and leaves assembly, signing and sending to the caller. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06)

text: VelocityClient reads account state in one of three modes, and each puts a different load on the RPC. Websocket is the default and pushes updates per account, but many RPC endpoints cap concurrent subscriptions. Polling uses BulkAccountLoader(connection, commitment, pollingFrequencyMs) to batch getMultipleAccounts calls, which gives predictable request volume on any RPC. The grpc mode uses a Yellowstone/Geyser stream and needs a gRPC-enabled provider such as Jito or Triton, an auth token, and usually a paid plan. Helius gates gRPC the same way: LaserStream gRPC is off on Free, devnet-only on Developer, and on for Business and Professional. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06)
